title: Keep the correction
hook: Two kinds of feedback after a wrong attempt: 'took 3 tries' or the item marked wrong.

knows: reading short labels and comparing simple counts
doesNotKnow: that feedback helps when it shows which item was wrong, so that item can be fixed, which a count of attempts does not

misconception: Knowing how many tries you needed is enough feedback.
objective: Use feedback to locate a specific mismatch instead of only counting attempts.

claims.text: Scenario, hook and prediction: Two kinds of feedback after a wrong attempt: 'took 3 tries' or the item marked wrong. Two kinds of feedback after a wrong attempt: 'took 3 tries' or the item marked wrong. Which lets you fix it next time? Correct option: Only the marked item. claims.text: Stage: a bike lock with the stipulated code 4 · 9 · 2 and a stipulated last try of 4 · 7 · 2 after 3 tries. “Count only” shows “3 tries · still locked”. “Mark each digit” marks digit 2 wrong and digits 1 and 3 right. Each digit box cycles through fixed choices (4, 1, 6; 7, 9, 1; 2, 5, 8); “Try again” adds a try and the lock opens only at 4 · 9 · 2. Reveal sentences: “3 tries, still locked” did not say which digit was wrong. The marks did: digit 2 (7) wrong, the rest right.

claims.text: Side-by-side comparison locates the wrong position; a count or a bare 'wrong' does not say which item.
claims.source: Recall item for this lesson: stipulated example data and the rule taught in the lesson (company/reviews/lifehacks-200/recall-patch-study.md + recall-patch-study.lines.txt). Applies to the example only; no empirical effect is claimed. Recall patch by learning-designer (session 2, 2026-10-14), applied by session 1. Pointer corrected by demo-builder 2026-10-14 (W-391a). | FC pass 35 (fact-checker, 2026-10-14): VERIFIED. Convention and logic: an attempt count or a bare "wrong" carries no position information, while a side-by-side comparison marks each position; the stage does exactly this (reconstructionMatches gives a per-position true/false and each attempt box turns green or red after Check). The keyed option (index 1) is the only one that locates the error. No empirical learning claim is made.

recall.question: You wrote a five-step sequence from memory. Which feedback tells you what to fix?
options: A note saying this was your third attempt
Your attempt beside the target, errors marked
A note saying 'not quite, try again'
recall.why: Side-by-side comparison locates the wrong position; a count or a bare 'wrong' does not say which item.
